notes.notes:
Changes in 0.0.67
- I've added a tutorial (no more confusion!)
- Added time speed adjustments for 'enemy turns', 'traversal', and 'battle phase switching'. (For those who find the game's pace too slow)
- Added Overkill (Damage enemy for remaining HP + max HP). Future relics will utilize this.
- Added Precise (Damage enemy for exact remaining HP). Future relics will utilize this.
- Added more SFX
- Fixed balls getting stuck in mining phase upon board refresh
- Fixed instances where gamepad mouse would not appear when needed
- Fixed "Press anykey" not fully triggering the main menu to appear
- Ensured that each playtest run MUST fight the necromancer
- Changed colour of invincible enemies to help ease confusion (Skele piles)
- Dialogue buttons no longer show if on gamepad (can still use D-Pad to respond)
- Loose rock's visuals are no longer behind the pegs
- Added 'AoE' and 'DoT' to help with bombs and totems
- Bombs now show their damage radius on hover
- Totems now bounce off of enemies whilst in motion instead of dissapearing
- Totems now display "Trampled" when an enemy walk over them
- Fixed particles to follow a standard pixelisation
- Shops no longer show duplicate balls
- Reworked minecart
- Added countdown to demo
- Flippers are now enabled at all times (no more waiting until you shoot the ball)
- Plenty more stuff that's been crossed off in my notepad but I can't make out what they are

[i]No new battles in this update, I'm saving them for the Demo release on the 7th? of August.[/i]

Changes in 0.0.61:
- Controller Support
- Mouse/Cursor hides when is not needed

Next up: Rebinds for controller (wanted to get this out first to get feedback on default layout)
Also note: controller glyphs are not in the game yet, controls use words instead for now :)

Changes in 0.0.55:
- Key rebinding (keyboard only)

Next up: Controller Support (then a proper tutorial)

Changes in 0.0.53:
- Replaced target dummy fight with a new battle (they'll make a return after a proper tutorial has been made).
- Replaced aim helper with a solid line.
- Significantly reduced damage taken on failed navigation (and capped this damage to 6).
- Removed '[M] World Map' until implemented.
- Added additional hitboxes to troll enemy (arms are now hittable).
- Fix sound bug at navigation
- Added ambient music to navigation
- Fixed spitting spider animations getting stuck

+ Probably more things I forgot to write down too, enjoy :)

Changes in 0.0.51:
- Fixed game soft-locking upon death
- Pause menu now shows controls

Changes in 0.0.50:
- The game is no longer stuck in the debug chest run. 

Thank you anonymous person for letting me know via the feedback form!

notes.title: 'Proof of Concept' Playtest now LIVE!
notes.notes: [p]Ahoy all, It's time to grab your balls & set sail![/p][p][/p][p]The first playtest for DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike is now live. You can now play a 7 encounter long run containing regular battles, mini-boss battles, random events, & chest events. [/p][p][/p][p]With this being the first play test, the amount of content in the game at the moment is of course small - but should show what you can expect from DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike going forward. Any and all feedback is appreciated, whether that be in the Steam Forums, Discord server, or feedback form (link also in-game). If you do screen record gameplay footage as feedback, feel free to send a youtube link (either public or unlisted) to contact@yetibytes.com.[/p][p][/p][p]Useful links:[/p][p]Discord - [url="https://discord.gg/mSBXyPhTwK"]https://discord.gg/mSBXyPhTwK[/url][/p][p]Feedback Form - [url="https://forms.gle/KroLTJrBpdrAicoJ8"]https://forms.gle/KroLTJrBpdrAicoJ8[/url][/p][p]Music info for content creators - [url="http://music.dwarrf.com"]http://music.dwarrf.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for checking out my game,[/p][p]Sam[/p][p][/p]
